historical_references.reference: The name 'Taseel' was given to the first mosque in Mecca by Caliph Umar Ibn Al-Khattab in 638 AD. It is believed that the name signifies the mosque being the 'foundation' or 'basis' of Islam in Mecca.

The name 'Taseel' was also used for the first university in Al-Karaouine, Morocco, founded in 859 AD by Fatima Al-Fihri. It is believed that the name symbolizes the university being the 'foundation' or 'basis' of knowledge and wisdom in the Islamic world.
